title: Harvest Home

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: They walked! Every one of them walked the roads to get here: Mrs. Hannah up the farm road, Mr. Finn from the lake, Mrs. Greta and Sam down from Bellhaven, Brother Elias over the bridge, Captain Mara along the coast road, and Mr. Silas all the way down the mountain!

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Before we eat, we say thank you. Will you say it for us, one more time?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Write the thank-you: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: for the {roads} that bring us together,
for every {roads} we walked this year,

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: This year you walked every road out of our valley, and now every road has brought a friend back to you.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Thank you, my dear friend. Happy Harvest Home! Come back tomorrow: the feast goes on, and Mrs. Greta has brought her market.

journal_line: At Harvest Home, friends from every corner of the land walked the roads to our valley, and I said the thank-you.
